 506|        """Create an in-memory ZIP archive of a directory."""
 507|        buf = io.BytesIO()

 510|            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(base):
 511|                # Skip hidden dirs
 512|                dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.')]
 513|                for f in files:
 514|                    if f.startswith('.'):
 515|                        continue
 516|                    fp = os.path.join(root, f)
 517|                    arcname = os.path.relpath(fp, base)
 518|                    zf.write(fp, arcname)
 519|        buf.seek(0)
